attr.title: SDR++
attr.desc: SDR++ is a cross-platform, bloat-free software defined radio receiver. Plug an RTL-SDR, Airspy, AirspyHF+ or HackRF into the USB port and use your handheld as a portable spectrum analyser and receiver, or connect over the network to an rtl_tcp, SpyServer or SDR++ Server host.
attr.inst:
Ready to run - no extra files needed.

A USB SDR receiver is required for local reception. Connect it to the USB OTG port (a powered OTG hub is strongly recommended: an RTL-SDR draws around 300mA, which is more than the port reliably supplies on its own). Supported out of the box: RTL-SDR, Airspy, AirspyHF+, HackRF. Without hardware you can still use the network sources or play back recorded IQ files.

Controls: the left stick moves the pointer, A left-clicks, B right-clicks, hold X for fine positioning. The right stick and d-pad step the pointer one pixel at a time for grabbing narrow VFO edges.

Audio comes out of the headphone jack via the built-in Audio Sink.
